description.value:
Spending an hour studying a structure from every angle you can access, and cross-referencing it against your own data, reveals its underlying blueprint: total hit points, common construction materials, whether it's occupied or abandoned, its floor count and each floor's likely purpose, every non-secret entrance (doors, windows, vents, pipes) and its location, a basic floor-by-floor and ventilation map, its probable builders and age, and any structural weak points.

Additionally, while carrying constructor's implements, an Investigation check you make to find hidden structural features (like secret doors or passages) in that structure treats a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
